status: fixed before any H9 fit; post-hoc development experiment after H8 schedule baseline was viewed
target_decomposition: raw next-day log close return = log1p(-known distribution / close_t) + residual
training_label: historically realized raw next-day close return minus log1p(-realized ex-date distribution / close_t); realized distribution is part of the completed training label, never an evaluation input
evaluation_schedule: only the three SGX manager announcements in data/reference/srt_announced_distributions_dev.csv, each issued before its forecast date
architecture: unchanged V1 Fuzzy2 with 20x6 input, 3D latent and two Gaussian/affine rules
training: V1 AdamW lr=0.001 wd=0.0001, batch=64, gradient clip=1.0, max_epochs=150, patience=20, min_improvement=0.0001, train-only standardizers; inner stop on residual MSE then outer restart/refit
evaluation: add only pre-announced deterministic adjustment to each predicted residual and expert output; score original raw close-return target on all 378 validation dates
advance_rule: three-seed mean pooled RMSE at least 1% below DivSchedule, >=2 folds of seed-mean RMSE better than DivSchedule, >=6/9 paired wins over V1 Fuzzy2+DivSchedule, pooled MAE no worse than 1% over DivSchedule
attribution_limit: if it wins, matched LSTM3 and ordinary Gate2 residual training are still required before assigning any gain to fuzzy rules
data_boundary: only validation folds; no final_holdout evaluation or model selection
